services.desc: Museum space is available for groups to schedule special events and meetings. Opportunities for collaboration on joint projects and exhibits are welcome. All security deposits are refundable within thirty (30) days if the Museum is undamaged. The Legacy Garden at The Woodson African American Museum of Florida is a sprawling vista complete with magnolias, a flowing fountain, a rose garden, and brick pathways. It is the result of a collaborative venture between the St. Petersburg Area Chamber of Commerce’s Leadership St. Pete Class of 2008, the city’s Midtown Economic Development Initiative, and the museum.
